context: The speaker is a newly converted goblin zealot (Greez) eager to recruit and explain the cult of the Absolute, especially the ritual brand placed on followers. That brand is applied in a chapel by the tribe’s priestess leaders — the Absolute’s clerics who believe they commune with the Absolute and are, in fact, tadpoled/True Souls — and is said to be magical and visible only to other followers. Branding marks membership and is used to identify who’s “on our side,” so unbranded outsiders draw suspicion or dismissal. The priestess’ friendliness can be a lure: she’s an influential leader who may manipulate or separate newcomers for darker ends. There is also internal strife in the camp—some goblins still worship Maglubiyet and are treated as heretics, even imprisoned.
